description.zh:
1607 年至 1640 年，明代地理学家徐霞客从江阴出发，游历太湖、泰山、天台、雁荡、庐山、黄山、武夷、华山、嵩山，晚年进行西南万里行，经浙江、江西、湖南、广西、贵州进入云南，抵达大理、丽江、腾冲。

> 本数据为 M74 示例初稿：路线为示意简化，事件日期、地点与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
From 1607 to 1640, the Ming dynasty geographer Xu Xiake traveled from Jiangyin to Lake Tai, Mount Tai, Tiantai, Yandang, Lushan, Huangshan, Wuyi, Huashan, and Songshan. In his later years he journeyed through Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guangxi, Guizhou, and Yunnan, reaching Dali, Lijiang, and Tengchong.

> M74 illustrative draft: routes are simplified; dates, places, and wording await historical review.

description.zh: 明代地理学家、旅行家，历时三十余年游历中国。
description.en: A Ming dynasty geographer and traveler who explored China for more than thirty years.
